name: Hammerskull
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Passive Perception 11. No listed skills, languages, or special senses.
appearance: A slate-blue and green bipedal herbivore with a thick plated head, small forelimbs, and a sturdy tail.

sections.Printed source:
James Wyatt, Plane Shift: Ixalan, first printing (January 2018), pp. 28–29. 
Uses Giant Goat from the 2014 Monster Manual, p. 326. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/16885-giant-goat
sections.Traits:
Charge. After moving straight toward a target at least 20 ft., the hammerskull adds 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage if it hits that target with Ram on the same turn. A creature hit this way must pass a DC 13 Strength save or fall prone.
Sure-Footed. Roll with advantage on Strength and Dexterity saves against effects that would knock the hammerskull prone.
sections.Actions: Ram. +5 to hit in melee, reach 5 ft., one target. The hit deals 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
sections.At the table: Use the Giant Goat’s numbers with the hammerskull’s plated head. The Charge damage applies on the hit. Only a creature rolls the save against being knocked prone.

name: Horned Frog
otherStatistics: Perception +2, Stealth +3. Darkvision 30 ft. Passive Perception 12. No listed languages.
appearance: An oversized, broad-mouthed frog with two short peaks above the eyes, mottled olive skin, and webbed feet.

sections.Printed source:
James Wyatt, Plane Shift: Ixalan, first printing (January 2018), p. 39. 
Uses Giant Frog from the 2014 Monster Manual, p. 325. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/16884-giant-frog
sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The horned frog breathes both air and water.
Standing Leap. Its long jump can reach 20 ft. and its high jump 10 ft. It needs no running start for either.
sections.Actions:
Bite. +3 to hit in melee, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage and grapple the target (escape DC 11). The target is restrained while the grapple lasts, and the frog cannot use Bite against another target in that time.
Swallow. Make a Bite attack against one Small or smaller creature the frog is grappling. A hit swallows the target and ends the grapple. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained and has total cover from attacks and other effects originating outside the frog. At the start of each of the frog’s turns, the target takes 5 (2d4) acid damage. The frog can hold one swallowed creature at a time. If the frog dies, the creature is no longer restrained and can spend 5 ft. of movement to emerge from the corpse, prone.
sections.At the table: The Bite grapple and restraint start on a hit. The size limit applies to Swallow, which requires its own successful Bite attack against a creature the frog already holds.

name: Macaw
otherStatistics: Perception +3. Passive Perception 13. No listed languages or special senses.
appearance: A broad tropical bird with a curved dark beak, a pale cheek patch, muted brick-red and blue plumage, and a long tapering tail.

sections.Printed source:
James Wyatt, Plane Shift: Ixalan, first printing (January 2018), p. 39. 
Uses Raven from the 2014 Monster Manual, p. 335. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/16992-raven
sections.Traits: Mimicry. The bird can imitate simple sounds it has heard, including snippets of humanoid voices. A listener who succeeds on a DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check can tell it is an imitation.
sections.Actions: Beak. +4 to hit in melee, reach 5 ft., one target. The hit deals a fixed 1 piercing damage.
sections.At the table: Use the printed Raven’s Tiny size and 50-ft. flight speed. The Ixalan account describes birds imitating travelers’ voices, and the Raven’s Mimicry rule gives the check to recognize the imitation.

name: Piranha
otherStatistics: Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 8. No listed skills or languages.
appearance: A small, round-bodied freshwater fish with silvery scales, a muted rusty belly, a forked tail, and sharp teeth.

sections.Printed source:
James Wyatt, Plane Shift: Ixalan, first printing (January 2018), p. 40. 
Uses Quipper from the 2014 Monster Manual, p. 335. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/16989-quipper
sections.Traits:
Blood Frenzy. The piranha has advantage on melee attacks against creatures below their hit point maximum.
Water Breathing. The piranha breathes only underwater.
sections.Actions: Bite. +5 to hit in melee, reach 5 ft., one target. The hit deals a fixed 1 piercing damage.
sections.At the table: Use the individual Quipper for this entry. The Swarm of Piranhas has a separate block based on the Swarm of Quippers.
